# Your paper {#yourpaper background-color="#f0674d"}

The rest of the afternoon runs on one paper: yours, or ours.

## Being written {#plan}

- **Before you open it:** the training switch off; leave out data you can't share;
  ask your co-authors. The draft alone carries most of the afternoon.
- **No paper with you?** The course files have one: a fictional paper in progress,
  with its data and a few problems.
- **Open the folder in the app.** *"What is this paper? Where is everything?"*
- **A save point** before anything changes.
- **Then start a job and keep going:** *Take it apart* runs while we talk.
